quality_boundary: Only deterministic synthetic workflow assertions; no scientific-quality score.
latency_boundary: Local verifier elapsed time only; not provider latency or a service-level objective.

known_limitations: The recipe validates local release files and loopback-domain behavior; it does not prove real-provider availability.
